text:
mira: Heads up—noticed a small fraction (~5%) of requests for tenant=acme with header X-Region are falling through to the default route even though the rule should match. decision logs show sampler skipped, but the route eval trace shows a match earlier. anyone seen header precedence/sampling weirdness?

alex: Can you paste a decision-log snippet + the trace id? also which sampler config are we using (tenant-prefix vs header-key)?

mira: Paste from one of the affected logs:
```
decision_log_id: dl-9f2a
route_eval: {"route_id":"acme_region","matched":false,"reason":"prefilter_mismatch"}
headers_seen: {"x-region":"eu-west"}
sampler: {"sampled":false,"sampler_key":"tenant:acme|header:X-Region"}
```
last_trace_id: trace-0001

tj: That sampler_key looks suspicious—it's using the original header name casing (X-Region). We canonicalize header names to lower-case later in the pipeline, so sampler might be looking up a different key than the rule evaluation does.

sam: Confirming: prefilter/sampler currently runs before header-normalize step in the pipeline for perf reasons. Means sampler sees raw incoming header map. Prefilter routing does header normalization later, so mismatch possible.

ops-bot: trace recorded: https://traces.redwood/trace-0001 (span ids 12/13). Decision-log attached to trace dl-9f2a.

alex: If that's the case we have two mitigation paths: 1) normalize headers earlier (change pipeline order) or 2) make sampler lookup both raw and normalized header variants. 1 is cleaner but riskier for deploy coupling.

mira: Quick experiment: toggled normalize_headers=true before sampler in staging and the failing requests now match as expected. So order is the root cause.

tj: Hotfix suggestion: implement dual-key lookup in sampler (check lower(header) and original) so we can patch fast without a full pipeline reorder. Then create a follow-up to move normalization earlier for correctness.

sam: Also propose adding an alert: if decision logs show >0.5% sampler_key mismatches for a tenant -> page eng-platform.

mira: Filed INF-3421 and opened PR for dual-key lookup: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1456. Also created a ticket to reorder pipeline: INF-3422.

alex: :thumbsup: assign hotfix to @tj?

tj: I'll take it. Will land the dual-lookup patch, run canary in staging, then promote. ETA today for staging, tomorrow for prod if green.

mira: Thanks. After rollout I'll post a short writeup in #eng-platform and add a dashboard tile showing sampler_key mismatch rate by tenant.

sam: Nice. Leave a note to add unit-tests for both header-casing scenarios and a regression test using trace-0001.

mira: Will do. Thanks everyone.
